correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the all-length prefix/suffix symmetry P_j=Q_j iff P_(n-j)=Q_(n-j): all length-j compositions have coordinate sum j, so distinct deletion choices are precisely distinct types. For n=2m+1 the duplicate count is D=1+2Z_m; for n=2m it is D=1+2Z_(m-1)+I_m. The return renewal F=1-1/U and first-return convolution give both parity-dependent PGFs. The projected difference walk has positive zero-step probability, full Z^(q-1) support and covariance determinant 2^(q-1)/q^q, yielding u_q,j ~ q^(q/2)/(4pi j)^((q-1)/2). Factorial moments give q=2 half-normal and q=3 exponential scales with correct n/2 substitution; q>=4 summability gives a geometric total return count. I independently enumerated input words directly for (q,n)=(2,7),(3,5),(4,4), finding deficit histograms respectively {1:40,3:40,5:32,7:16}, {1:144,3:72,5:27}, {1:180,2:12,3:48,4:16}; these are finite corroboration only.

evidence: Classical random-walk local CLT and renewal theory supply intermediate return laws. A related full Resultary RESULT.md enumerates length-six composition-deck reconstruction fibers, not deleted-type multiplicity for random words.
